mapper.select: SELECT element_id AS elementId, code, sort_no AS sortNo, name FROM shrine_element ORDER BY sort_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_element (site_id, element_id, local_name, note) VALUES (#{siteId}, #{elementId}, #{localName}, #{note}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE local_name = VALUES(local_name), note = VALUES(note)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM site_element WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND element_id = #{elementId}
